shortBulletSummary: Geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz trigger a crypto sell-off amid risk-off sentiment.
Bitcoin drops below $62,000 due to geopolitical concerns, cooling ETF inflows, and leveraged long liquidations.
Bitcoin and Ethereum spot ETFs record significant net inflows after weeks of outflows, indicating a potential reversal in institutional sentiment.
Markets await upcoming US CPI, PPI data, and Fed Chair testimony, which could influence interest rate expectations.
Bitcoin struggles to break above $64,000 resistance, and the Fear & Greed Index remains in Extreme Fear.
